steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?

views.text: In July 2024, Equity Mates described Paramount Global as a major Hollywood studio with TV networks like Nickelodeon and Comedy Central plus Australia’s Channel 10, and noted it also ran the Paramount Plus streaming service.

episode.title: Half year market wrap, the worst investing take, struggling Australian media & Pimp My Portfolio

views.text: In August 2023, Equity Mates recounted how Paramount backed Paranormal Activity after it was acquired, turning an ultra low‑budget horror into a hit and highlighting the studio’s distribution clout.
In July 2023, Equity Mates noted Paramount operated Paramount Plus but reported a $575 million quarterly loss, showing the scale and cost of the service in a competitive streaming market.

episode.title: Lights, Camera, Action - STRIKE! What's going on in Hollywood?

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In July 2026, Equity Mates said too many streaming services chased cancelling subscribers and discussed talk of Warner Brothers Discovery merging with Paramount, underscoring a tough competitive landscape where consolidation was likely.

episode.title: Entertainment: The Smartphone Is Eating Hollywood | The Decade Ahead

views.text: In June 2026, a guest on Equity Mates said about 75% of Paramount’s revenue still came from traditional TV with affiliate fees falling 5 to 7% annually, and estimated only ~7% streaming share, signalling pressure on profitability.

episode.title: 4 anti-hype anti-AI compounders, with Chloe Stokes and James Rodda

views.text: In May 2023, Equity Mates played AGM comments that streaming needed fewer players or much higher prices, discussed after Paramount cut its dividend by 80% and disappointed on earnings, pointing to challenged industry economics.

steps.q: Can it reinvest its profits productively?

views.text: In September 2025, Equity Mates reported the Ellison-backed group had bought full control of Paramount Global and then secured UFC rights, South Park streaming and top creators, signalling aggressive reinvestment into content.

episode.title: Larry Ellison's historic week, Pimp my Portfolio & the power of voluntary super contributions

views.text: In April 2024, Equity Mates explained Paramount’s control sat with National Amusements, which negotiated with Skydance despite a reported $26 billion all‑cash Apollo offer, raising alignment questions that could shape deal terms and capital allocation.

episode.title: Adam Dawes joins for Pimp my Portfolio, TikTok's worst advice pt.2 & meet Channel 10's new (potential) owner

views.text: In May 2023, Equity Mates highlighted Paramount’s 80% dividend cut discussed at Berkshire’s AGM, indicating management was conserving cash amid streaming losses.

steps.q: Can it be bought at a reasonable price?

views.text: In June 2026, a guest on Equity Mates expected the post merger business to be heavily leveraged and to trade on a high single digit to low double digit earnings multiple, framing valuation against debt load.

episode.title: 4 anti-hype anti-AI compounders, with Chloe Stokes and James Rodda

views.text: In May 2024, Equity Mates contrasted Apple’s record buyback with the roughly A$102 billion combined market value of listed legacy media, including Paramount, illustrating how out of favour sector valuations were.

episode.title: Highlights from Berkshire Hathaway, Apple’s record buyback & crypto’s record price

views.text: In May 2023, Equity Mates noted Paramount’s share price fell about 25% after weak results and a dividend cut, showing how rapidly sentiment shifted and what the market priced in at the time.
